collection.description: An important carved counting token slips beneath a narrow storage platform where adults cannot see it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: An important carved counting token slips beneath a narrow storage platform where adults cannot see it.

choices.label: Ask a Small Child to Look from a Safe Distance
Invite Children to Devise a Retrieval Tool
Treat the Loss as a Lesson

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (child) spots the token wedged beside a pebble and directs (adult) to it.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) notices a second missing token, revealing that the inventory was miscounted.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) fashions a slender reed hook and (adult) retrieves the token.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their first hook bends, and the children redesign it with a sturdier twig.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children identify which baskets must be shifted before adults lift the platform safely.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The platform is too heavy; (child) suggests accessing it from the other side instead.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) proposes a covered token tray, preventing a repeat mishap.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
d1__fx.text: (child) draws a map of the gap so the next search takes minutes.
